svg.title: Neovim editing AlucarDWeb.lua: Ferdinando, iOS~AI engineer at Wallapop in Barcelona, agentic era maximalist and accelerationist, Neovim enthusiast, building tools for coding agents

g.text: -- Code review in Neovim with a headless coding agent next to the diff.
-- It explains the hunk under the cursor or reviews the whole change, and
-- your comments go to a pending GitHub review. It drives Claude Code, pi
-- The compiler's code graph of a Swift or Objective-C project, plus the
-- commit history with PR descriptions and the repo's docs, as MCP tools.
-- In the repo's benchmarks agents use 20 to 48% fewer tokens with it, at
-- A Claude Code plugin that finds the skills and memories you've stopped
-- using and archives the ones you pick. Archived items can be restored.
-- Native Android and iOS clients for a self-hosted Hermes agent. They
-- speak the same WebSocket protocol as the Hermes TUI and desktop app.
